approaches_tried.approach: Generic NLP-style imperative detection across all 90 agent files
approaches_tried.reason: Initial run found 2 false positives: literature-agent.md's purely descriptive body (self-disclaims being spawnable) and the test script's own Case-7 grep pattern self-matching its own source. Fixed via a file-level exemption (grep for the file's own 'NOT a spawnable agent definition' disclaimer) and a --exclude on the test script's own filename.
